body.size.source: Gardon et al. 2018 (10.1021/acs.est.8b00168), Methods: height 5.9 ± 0.41 cm, oysters 1-1.5 y
note: Previous value 9.8 cm was a field-survey mean for a different population (not the tested animals).

body.size.source: Capolupo et al. 2021 (10.3390/nano11030649): sexually mature mussels, shell length 4-6 cm (midpoint)
note: Previous value 15 cm was the species maximum. Midpoint of the reported range (between-animal variability).
Reported as 'size'; assumed shell length. Previous value 15 cm was the species maximum.

body.size.source: Not reported in Masiá et al. 2021 (10.3390/ani11082317) or its supplement; imputed as the larger of the two measured M. galloprovincialis studies (Abidli et al. 2021)
note: Imputed (larger-value rule). Ask the authors for measured sizes.

body.size.source: Lo & Chan 2018 (10.1016/j.envpol.2017.10.095): control larvae 624 ± 55.5 µm at 16 d post-hatching (larger-value rule); 308 µm at release as lower bound
note: Previous value 6 cm was the adult size. All database rows are coded Early (larval growth / settlement endpoints); post-settlement juvenile lengths were not available.

body.size.source: Interpolated to day 12 (end of growth test) from T. gratilla culture total lengths of 311.7 µm (day 2) and 544.7 µm (day 16); Kaposi et al. 2014 (10.1021/es404295e) body length 90-96 µm kept as lower sensitivity bound
note: Previous value 10 cm was the adult size. Estimated from another culture; flagged. DOI is stored as 0.1021/es404295e in the database.

body.size.source: Au et al. 2015 (10.1002/etc.3093): neonates < 7 d, 10-d acute test; 19-d-old H. azteca average 3.40 ± 0.24 mm (NBS RIB 95-04)
note: Previous value 0.78 cm is at or above the adult maximum. Mouth size stays the reported 0.112 mm (Koelmans et al. 2020).

body.size.source: Au et al. 2015 (10.1002/etc.3093): 42-d chronic test (~7 weeks old at end); 7-week-old males average 5.64 mm (Khan et al., Environ Toxicol Chem, 10.1002/etc.5781)
note: Larger-value rule (male mean). Mouth size stays the reported 0.112 mm (Koelmans et al. 2020).
